Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that starts a streaming recognizer with language and punctuation settings using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 2 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 3 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 4 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 5 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 6 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
import time
import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk

def start_streaming_recognizer_with_settings():
    """
    Starts a streaming speech recognizer with specific language and punctuation settings
    using Azure AI Speech services.
    """
    try:
        speech_key = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"]
        speech_region = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"]
    except KeyError:
        print("Error: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION environment variables must be set.")
        return

    # --- 1. Configure the recognizer ---
    # Create speech configuration with credentials.
    speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=speech_key, region=speech_region)

    # Set the language to recognize.
    speech_config.speech_recognition_language = "en-US"

    # Enable dictation mode to get punctuation, capitalization, etc.
    speech_config.enable_dictation()

    # Use the default microphone as the audio source.
    audio_config = speechsdk.audio.AudioConfig(use_default_microphone=True)

    # Create the speech recognizer.
    speech_recognizer = speechsdk.SpeechRecognizer(speech_config=speech_config, audio_config=audio_config)

    # --- 2. Define event handlers ---
    # These functions will be called when specific events occur.

    # Fired for intermediate recognition results.
    def recognizing_handler(evt: speechsdk.SpeechRecognitionEventArgs):
        print(f"RECOGNIZING: {evt.result.text}")

    # Fired for final, recognized speech.
    def recognized_handler(evt: speechsdk.SpeechRecognitionEventArgs):
        if evt.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.RecognizedSpeech:
            print(f"RECOGNIZED: {evt.result.text}")
        elif evt.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.NoMatch:
            print(f"NO MATCH: Speech could not be recognized.")

    # Fired when recognition is canceled.
    def canceled_handler(evt: speechsdk.SpeechRecognitionCanceledEventArgs):
        print(f"CANCELED: Reason={evt.reason}")
        if evt.reason == speechsdk.CancellationReason.Error:
            print(f"CANCELED: ErrorDetails={evt.error_details}")

    # Fired when the session stops.
    def session_stopped_handler(evt: speechsdk.SessionEventArgs):
        print(f"SESSION STOPPED: {evt}")
        # This is a good place to signal the main loop to exit.
        nonlocal done
        done = True

    # --- 3. Connect handlers to the recognizer's events ---
    speech_recognizer.recognizing.connect(recognizing_handler)
    speech_recognizer.recognized.connect(recognized_handler)
    speech_recognizer.canceled.connect(canceled_handler)
    speech_recognizer.session_stopped.connect(session_stopped_handler)
    
    # --- 4. Start the recognition ---
    print("Starting streaming recognizer for 'en-US' with punctuation. Speak into your microphone.")
    speech_recognizer.start_continuous_recognition()

    # --- 5. Wait for recognition to complete ---
    # The `done` flag will be set to True by the `session_stopped_handler`.
    done = False
    while not done:
        time.sleep(0.5)

    # The stop_continuous_recognition() is not strictly needed here since the session
    # stop event will already have been handled, but it's good practice for explicit cleanup.
    speech_recognizer.stop_continuous_recognition()
    print("Recognizer stopped.")

# To run this code, you would call the function:
# start_streaming_recognizer_with_settings()
